title.zh: 【俄罗斯通过币安披露的信息，判处一名资助乌克兰的 IT 专家 13 年监禁】
title.en: 【俄罗斯通过币安披露的信息，判处一名资助乌克兰的 IT 专家 13 年监禁】

current_state.zh: A Russian court sentenced an IT specialist to 13 years for allegedly financing terrorism, relying on Binance transaction records — including transfers to Ukrainian fundraising campaigns — that the exchange provided to Russian investigators.
current_state.en: A Russian court sentenced an IT specialist to 13 years for allegedly financing terrorism, relying on Binance transaction records — including transfers to Ukrainian fundraising campaigns — that the exchange provided to Russian investigators.
